import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv

#check_failure Roth.normOne_zero
namespace NormZeroRaw
open MvPolynomial
variable {σ : Type*}
noncomputable def normOne80 (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ d ∈ P.support, |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)|
theorem direct : normOne80 (0 : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) = 0 := by
  change (0 : (σ →₀ ℕ) →₀ ℤ).sum (fun _ z ↦ |(z : ℝ)|) = 0
  exact Finsupp.sum_zero_index
theorem replay : normOne80 (0 : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) = 0 := by
  simp [normOne80]
theorem generic {ι M N : Type*} [Zero M] [AddCommMonoid N]
    (size : ι → M → N) : (0 : ι →₀ M).sum size = 0 := Finsupp.sum_zero_index
theorem genericPolynomial {R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid A]
    (size : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R → A) :
    (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).coeff.sum size = 0 := Finsupp.sum_zero_index
theorem sizeZeroUnnecessary :
    (0 : Unit →₀ ℤ).sum (fun _ _ ↦ (1 : ℕ)) = 0 := Finsupp.sum_zero_index
#check @Finsupp.sum_zero_index
#check @Polynomial.sum_zero_index
#check @MvPolynomial.support_zero
#print axioms direct
#print axioms replay
#print axioms generic
#print axioms genericPolynomial
#print axioms sizeZeroUnnecessary
end NormZeroRaw
